ABTASTY_ENVIRONMENT_ID.description: AB Tasty says nothing about either half anywhere reachable, while shipping the same pair into a React SDK it says runs client-side or server-side. Silence resolves to secret here, but that sits in tension with its own design and is worth revisiting.
